INDIGO short overalls over CREAM short-sleeve tee, barefoot soft rabbit hind paws, two front hand-paws/two hind legs, can stand or squat, NOT a human wearing rabbit head. ELEPHANT: about1.6 times rabbit BODY HEIGHT excluding rabbit ears, BROAD ROUNDED heavy body, BLUE-GREY skin with subtle creases, huge fan-shaped ears, short thick TRUNK curling slightly upward, tiny drooping eyes, WIDE friendly laughing mouth, NO tusks. BRICK RED short waistcoat only, no pants, crown or footwear. TWO front arm-like limbs and TWO sturdy hind legs, clear anthropomorphic upright elephant anatomy, no extra pair of arms/legs.
